names: A transcript driver row files the CALL'S words at its quote's folded match (case kept, whitespace runs as one space), never the model's case or spacing of them, and the private spool holds a passage whose quote differs only in what the key folds as the same passage: the bytes filed first stand, and the page gains one QA flag naming the record's key and the day it was filed. GOOGL's paid build (run 8d2e72e8, $3.84) was refused after every model call (EvidenceBytesDifferError on its Q2 2026 call's paragraph 8, filed 2026-11-10). A read-only census of the 2,757 spool files on 2026-11-14: 1,472 claims; of 1,285 passages, 1,098 are their call's words byte for byte, 3 differ in one capital letter, 77 name a call not on disk and 107 are call-only. driver_evidence.py now writes a page field (the flag), so it is pinned
